mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE visible_scope (organization_unit_id, include_descendants) AS ( SELECT scope_target_id, include_descendants FROM seal.user_scope WHERE admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} AND scope_type = 'ORGANIZATION' UNION SELECT child.organization_unit_id, TRUE FROM seal.organization_unit child JOIN visible_scope parent_scope ON child.parent_id = parent_scope.organization_unit_id WHERE parent_scope.include_descendants = TRUE ), visible_actor AS ( SELECT user_account.admin_user_id FROM seal.admin_user user_account JOIN visible_scope scope ON scope.organization_unit_id = user_account.organization_unit_id ) SELECT event.event_id, event.occurred_at, event.actor_type, actor.display_name AS actor_display_name, event.action_code, event.target_type, event.target_id, event.result, event.reason_code, event.correlation_id FROM seal.audit_event event LEFT JOIN seal.admin_user actor ON actor.admin_user_id = event.actor_id WHERE event.occurred_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7 days' AND (event.actor_type = 'SYSTEM' OR event.actor_id IN (SELECT admin_user_id FROM visible_actor)) ORDER BY event.occurred_at DESC, event.event_id DESC LIMIT 200
